hold_style: if a cone is held, it must be one of the countable set (not an extra)
hand_action: characters may steady cones on the counter or gently touch one countable cone — never invent an extra cone
surface_action: all cones stand in holders or rest carefully on the counter (total equals placeholder count)
interaction_prompt: TOTAL visible ice cream cones must equal the placeholder count — held cones count toward that total.
